record.question: Based on Census 2011, which of the following district has the highest sex ratio in Mizoram
record.explanation: Census 2011 district sex ratios for Mizoram: Aizawl 1009, Saiha 979, Champhai 984, Serchhip 977, Kolasib 956, Lunglei 947, Lawngtlai 945, Mamit 927. Aizawl's raw enumeration (199,270 males vs 201,039 females) gives 201039/199270 x 1000 = 1009 females per 1000 males, the highest in the state; Champhai (984) is the highest among the other listed options but still below Aizawl, and Mamit was the lowest at 927. Source PDF OCR confirms the question and options exactly as given.
